facts.title: OneSource Specialty Pharma Ltd
facts.takeaway: OneSource reported Q1 FY27 revenue of Rs 446 crore with net profit more than doubling year on year; a June USFDA inspection of its Bengaluru site ended with one observation.

facts.title: OneSource Specialty Pharma reports Q1 standalone net profit of ₹512M vs ₹248M YoY
facts.takeaway: OneSource reported Q1 FY27 standalone net profit of ₹51.2 crore, up from ₹24.8 crore a year earlier.
